sloka: एवं तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य राक्षसाः।नादं चक्रुर्महाघोरं कम्पयन्त इवार्णवम् ।। ६.६५.४७ ।।
transliteration: evaṁ tasya bruvāṇasya kumbhakarṇasya rākṣasāḥ।nādaṁ cakrurmahāghoraṁ kampayanta ivārṇavam ।। 6.65.47 ।।

translations.english: As wise Kumbhakarna was proceeding swiftly , dreadful portents appeared.
